title: Prime Minister extends greetings on Milad-un-Nabi
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has greeted everyone on the occasion of Milad-un-Nabi.
Shri Modi expressed hope that the occasion would further strengthen the spirit of togetherness and spread joy all around. He also wished that the spirit of kindness and giving back to society would always guide everyone.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
Eid Mubarak!
Greetings on Milad-un-Nabi. I hope this occasion furthers togetherness and joy all around us. May the spirit of kindness and giving back to society always guide us.
Eid Mubarak! Greetings on Milad-un-Nabi. I hope this occasion furthers togetherness and joy all around us. May the spirit of kindness and giving back to society always guide us. — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 26, 2026
***
MJPS/SS/VJ

enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended greetings to the nation on the occasion of Milad-un-Nabi. He expressed hope that the festival would strengthen togetherness and spread joy, and wished that a spirit of kindness and social service would guide everyone. The greeting was posted on social media platform X on 26 August 2026.
enrichment.context: Milad-un-Nabi, also known as Eid-e-Milad, marks the birth anniversary of Prophet Muhammad and is observed by Muslims worldwide, including a significant population in India. It is customary for the Prime Minister and other constitutional functionaries to issue greetings on major religious festivals of various communities as a gesture of India's pluralistic and secular ethos. Such greetings are largely ceremonial in nature and do not carry policy content.
